items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Let me see, Wally Harris, The House of Blues and Booze.

ctx.x: No, this was a club they had, they a concession. And they had a sign up. So he went out there one day, wasn't nobody there, and took some paint and changed it. Let me see, Wally Harris, The House of Blues and Booze. And the liquor authority didn't like it. They wanted to take that sign down. The House of Blues and Booze.
